message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Explanation | |---|------|-------------| | 1 | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands at the end of each round. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | 4 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. | | 5 | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | 6 | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | 7 | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: draw two cards. | | 8 | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | 9 | **Continuing Play** | After scoring, a new round begins with a fresh shuffle and deal. | |10 | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards to avoid drawing.
• **Custom Rules** – e.g., “Draw Two” can be played on any card, not just matching color. | **Key Takeaway:** Play cards that match the top card’s color, number, or symbol; use special cards strategically; remember to call “UNO” when you’re down to one card; and keep score to reach the target points.
